caption: The drawing depicts an oval platter with a white base color and a decorative border around the rim, featuring a floral or foliage pattern in shades of green and possibly blue. The platter is drawn in the center of a lightly outlined square frame. Below the main illustration, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the platter showing its top view and side profile for additional reference. To the left of this smaller drawing, the text reads "GREENWOOD CHINA TRENTON, N.J." indicating the manufacturer and location. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name "A. Sudick." The overall composition is rendered in soft pencil or ink with subtle color accents used for the decoration on the platter. The background of the image is an off-white or light beige color.
